claims.text: The Palms is an all-suite resort spanning 12 acres on Grace Bay Beach.

findings.quote: The Palms Turks and Caicos is an exquisite all-suite resort spanning 12 acres at the heart of the famous Grace Bay Beach

claims.text: The resort is on the island of Providenciales, steps from the white sands of Grace Bay Beach.

findings.quote: A 72 all-suite resort on the island of Providenciales
Located just steps away from the flawless white sands and sparkling turquoise waters of Grace Bay Beach

claims.text: The resort has a 25,000-square-foot spa.

findings.quote: a 25,000 square foot spa

claims.text: At the spa, mornings begin with yoga and pilates classes, and there are cabanas, a sauna and a steam room.

findings.quote: Mornings begin with yoga and pilates classes; there are tinkling water features and cabanas to retreat to before or after a treatment; as well as a sauna and steam room

claims.text: Life at The Palms centers on the pool, with a swim-up bar, loungers and day beds.

findings.quote: Life at The Palms orbits around the pool—and for good reason considering the swim-up bar, swaying palm trees, and ample options of loungers and day beds.

claims.text: All suites have king-sized beds with custom hand-tufted bedding and a coffee and espresso maker.

findings.quote: All suites at The Palms Turks and Caicos feature king-sized beds with custom hand-tufted bedding
coffee and espresso maker

claims.text: Many suites have an in-suite washer/dryer and a full kitchen.

findings.quote: Many suites also boast an in-suite washer/dryer and a full kitchen

claims.text: All suites come with spacious balconies, many with ocean views.

findings.quote: all suites come with spacious balconies to wind down on after a day of sun, many of which have excellent views of the ocean

claims.text: Bathrooms have marble floors and showers and deep tubs.

findings.quote: The bathrooms, however, have already received a thorough facelift, with gleaming marble floors and showers, often with two separate heads, and deep tubs to soak in.

claims.text: Guests can use a tennis court and bicycles to explore the area.

findings.quote: guests can enjoy the convenience of both a tennis court for some spirited matches and bicycles to explore the surrounding area with ease

claims.text: A 24-hour concierge sets up experiences on the water such as snorkeling or a sunset cruise.

findings.quote: a 24-hour concierge to set up experiences on the water (say snorkeling, or a sunset cruise)

claims.text: The two signature restaurants are Parallel23 and SiSi Restaurante.

findings.quote: Two signature restaurants, Parallel23 and SiSi Restaurante

claims.text: The spa takes up an entire acre of the 12-acre property.

findings.quote: which takes up an entire acre of the 12-acre property

claims.text: A serpentine infinity pool lies at the heart of the resort.

findings.quote: Lying at the heart of The Palms Turks and Caicos luxury resort, the superbly sculpted serpentine infinity pool

claims.text: Penthouses have up to four private balconies and a private Sun Suite with outdoor shower.

findings.quote: Penthouses feature up to four private balconies as well as a private Sun Suite with outdoor shower.

claims.text: A butler service makes sure there is a cooler of iced water beside your sun lounger.

findings.quote: a butler service that will always make sure there’s a cooler of iced water beside your sun lounger at the start of the day

claims.text: The Conch Kritters Club is the resort's kids club, for ages 4 to 12, with full and half days.

findings.quote: including our Conch Kritters Club
a dedicated children’s club provides fun and excitement for our younger guests
has a kids club on site that will accommodate ages 4-12 for both full and half days

claims.text: Suites look out either on the Caribbean Ocean or on the landscaped gardens, so not every suite faces the sea.

findings.quote: Whether you select a suite with infinite Caribbean Ocean views or mature meticulously landscaped gardens

claims.text: Families abound at the resort.

findings.quote: Families abound at this resort

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires flight connections.
